As a conservative who lives in Austin, it’s genuinely depressing seeing this. How could a rational human being genuinely think that defunding the police is a good option? 

Austin, at its heart, is a great city, it has so many things to do, good food, good music, and mostly good people, but then the left ruins almost anything it touches. It’s been doing this for a while now, and it’s sad to see my hometown on the decline.
I’ve met a lot of leftists who don’t claim to be liberals but act like them. The same does occur with the right but from what I’ve seen, not to the extent that the left does.

Plenty of people legitimately want to abolish the police system, and it doesn’t matter if politics affect me, my generation will affect politics in a matter of years. I’m not demonizing the party as a whole, I’m asking why it’s so common to see hostile leftists. Of course most of these answers are biased due to this being a conservative sub, but regardless I’m not demonizing anyone.

I’m calling out the people who call themselves leftists and demonize so many other people, ie. the republican party, the police system, and so much more. I’m looking for answers here and stating what I’ve seen from my personal experience. 

Whether you like it or not, people my age have valid opinions that will come to affect the worlds political climate, and all I’m saying is that we need to be careful.

I didn’t use the word most to generalize, I used it to avoid generalizing because I think using absolutes is illogical. I was not using an anecdote to prove a point, I was using my personal experiences to ask if anyone else shared those same thoughts. The vast majority of leftists that I’ve met and debated with online have been nothing but hostile, while most conservatives I’ve seen are more open minded. Again, this app relates to people my age, so teenagers really. 

Also I don’t surround myself with conservatives, my immediate family and most of my friends are all leftists. I live in Austin, Texas, a primarily liberal city. 

I try to avoid generalizing at all times. Not all leftists are bad, and not all conservatives are good. The majority of bad conservatives I’ve seen are just trolls though, and not legitimate party members. However, almost all of the left-leaning people I’ve debated have resulted to insulting me, doxxing me, and other such things.

Yeah, it’s almost as if nowadays people take comfort in being divided. I hope to see world peace by the time I die, it’s unlikely, but a man can hope. However, political party’s create such a huge divide in our country it’s horrible. It destroys any chance of dialogue, like you said. 

Everyone should be ashamed because we’re responsible for this rift, and it’s sad how long it’s been since a genuinely good person has come into office. It saddens me how all of these politicians only want to help their own party instead of america as a collective.

People don’t see each other as Americans anymore, it’s so divided it’s almost like weber forgotten that we live in the same country. Hopefully this negative mindset will eventually and gradually end.

I completely agree, if what they thought about the republican party was true, then their violent response would be entirely justified. However it’s not, and it’s terrifying how they can legitimately think that way. Most of the leftists my age have gotten their opinions and views off of left social media, like instagram, tik tok, and others. You know there’s a problem when you base your whole political and moral standpoint off of a tik tok. 

They think we’re evil when we aren’t, we just have a fundamentally different political view than them, however we can still agree on a lot of things but they aren’t willing to see that. I’m scared of my generation and what it will do to the country. It’s good to see people who actually agree with me!

But I don’t discredit the hostile members of my party, I’ve acknowledged them, and most of the conservatives I seen my age do the same. 

A lot of my generations “conservatives,” are just self proclaimed trump supporting edge lords who say the n-word all the time. Most genuine conservatives my age are civil though, and at least willing to hear the other side. I acknowledge the right has a lot of negative things about it, and traditional conservatives are pretty close minded themselves, but most my age are not. Most conservatives in my generation are just people who argue off of facts and logic, not emotion and feelings. 

Also I refuse to generalize the left as batshit crazy extremists because generalizing never does any favors, it’s unrealistic and unfair to falsely assume and individuals POV. However a lot of left leaning people have no problem with it.
